name: Wilderness step W1.5, two players (run with wilderness-pvp-single-way-test2.json on the other VM at the same time): test, at level 50 in single-way combat beside a cow it spawned, punches test2, which starts its PJ timer; Attack on the cow is refused with the line for being under attack, and allowed once the 20 ticks are up

steps.comment: on our tile, standing still; the Wilderness has no multi-way areas yet, so this is single-way
once test2 has jumped here too, its sign that it's ready
a punch made: both PJ timers run (OSRS Wiki, PJ timer: 20 ticks in the Wilderness)
ends the punching, and is refused
the timer over: test2 has auto retaliate off, so nothing set it again
away, test2's sign that we're done
